correctness.rationale: For singleton identity, the decomposition axiom means precisely that any class meeting a setwise product AB is wholly contained in AB. Inversion is compatible exactly when every inverse image of a class is a class. The independent standard-library reproduction uses unordered bit-mask blocks with singleton identity, constructs the group tables and inverse maps, and tests all ordered products for whole-block saturation. Its recursion inserts the next point into one nonidentity block or starts a new block; deleting the last point shows this is complete and nonredundant, and Bell numbers independently check the number generated. The transcript gives 22 accepted and 12 inverse-incompatible from 52 candidates on S₃, and 44 and 4 from 678,570 on C₁₂; the four are exactly the orbit of the given witness under the four unit multipliers. It also checks the quantified decomposition axiom on every accepted partition of both boundary groups. C₁–C₁₁ and the noncyclic types C₂², C₄×C₂, C₂³ and C₃² all have zero failures; these include all groups below six and all abelian groups below twelve. Both computed witness tables have the identity in X*X and X*Y, ruling out a unique inverse. Replay using python3 /workspace/branches/f2b1f51a-ca2f-402c-8241-3d8b2da3040f/independent_dimensionality_census.py; sibling reproduction.txt:1–25 records the counts, orbit and quotient tables. Inspected the original proof, VERIFICATION.md and its checker without executing uploaded code. The supplied checker's optional direct-axiom loop is skipped for C₁–C₈, contrary to a blanket description in RESULT.md:46; exact saturation with the proved equivalence is sufficient for those groups. No enumeration of all abelian order-twelve groups or formal verification is claimed.

value.rationale: This is a motivated first-obstruction calculation for a published structural hypothesis, not an arbitrary small-group census. The examples show why inversion cannot be omitted even for abelian inputs, while the exhaustions determine how small either obstruction can be and the extent of its occurrence at two natural boundaries. The exceptional orbit and explicit quotient tables distinguish one cyclic obstruction type from four labeled partitions.
